clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Fire is a quest from the Windshapers commanding the execution of Skypriest Faladiel, a former brother who betrayed his order for power. Adventurers must track the rogue skypriest to the Gustberry Lowlands and retrieve his heart to fuel a powerful elemental ritual.

Call of Fire tasks adventurers with hunting down Skypriest Faladiel, a former Windshaper who abandoned his loyalties to join the Al'Aketh. Once a dedicated caller of flame, Faladiel chose power over allegiance, turning on his fellow order members and leaving their blood upon his hands. The Windshapers dispatch an agent to deliver their uncompromising judgment upon him.

Faladiel has secluded himself at a farm within the Gustberry Lowlands, situated northeast past Valanaar and just south of the Shrine of Akir. Slaying the rogue skypriest serves more than mere vengeance; the Windshapers require his heart as a grisly component for an upcoming ritual, believing that consuming the heart of a betrayer allows their sacred flames to burn with unmatched intensity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor.
This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to be done.
